title: Picture naming
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG recordings from 108 individuals who performed a picture-naming task, with electrode coordinates provided in MNI-305 space. The data support investigations into the neural dynamics underlying language production, particularly the timing of facilitative and compensatory neural interactions during naming. The dataset was used in the analysis reported by Kochi et al. (2025).
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded from 108 patients during a picture-naming task. Each EDF file is tagged with event codes marking stimulus onset (401) and response onset (501). Electrode coordinates were registered to MNI-305 space.
